apps.name: SideInstaller
apps.subtitle: An an app that installs Sidestore on iOS 27, fully on-device
apps.localizedDescription: Install SideStore and LiveContainer directly on your iPhone. No PC required.
apps.versionDescription:
- Fixed the urgent anisette error -80045
   - Please note, apps such as Sidestore and Livecontainer still need to patch this error, so you may still get it on those apps. That doesn't depend on me
- The app now uses glass for its buttons
- Improved accessibility by making the ToS checkbox an actual checkbox
